people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua did to them as Yahweh told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
translations.bsb: Joshua treated them as the LORD had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned up their chariots.
translations.kjv: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
translations.asv: And Joshua did unto them as Jehovah bade him: he hocked their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
